restrictions: Two-block messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' of 128 bytes; complete SHA-256 with the standard IV, steps 0..30 on all three padded blocks, full feed-forward and all 256 digest bits. M1 and M1' differ in words 5..9.

Published attack, not new cryptanalysis: Li-Liu-Wang (EUROCRYPT 2024) single-starting-point two-block attack with the Li-Liu-Wang-Dong-Sun (ASIACRYPT 2024) matching. Characteristic, starting point and published pair are theirs. Package structure follows public submission 654cb3d (jagnani73), credited as co-author; all counts re-derived independently.

First blocks come in G = 238*2^24 groups of L = 2^16: each group draws W0..W15 from fresh uniform coins and trial j uses W15 = r15 + j, so every trial block is marginally exactly uniform (proof Lemma 4); groups are independent. Steps 0..14, W16, W18, W20, step-15 base constants, and group-invariant schedule partial sums c17, c19, c21..c29 are computed once per group; each trial is charged 1136 word operations at 1/2140 (987 counted + 149 reload allowance), giving total < 159.464 * 2^40 < 2^47.3171 < 2^47.32 including T0 = 2^45 advice construction.

Hard caps on every run: N = 238*2^40 trials, at most 2^38 key hits (1024 ops each), at most 2^20 Phase-3 calls (< 2^20 units each), no restarts. The time bound is a cap; only the success probability uses heuristics H1-H4.
Advice: one published starting point, 188 bytes; its construction is charged as T0 = 2^45 units under heuristic H3 (doubled versus 654cb3d).
Lemma 1 of 654cb3d (pairwise-disjoint acceptance sets) is false; an explicit overlap witness is given and a Bonferroni lower bound (relative deficit < 5.6e-7) is used instead.
Every output is re-hashed; acceptance tests are exact modular equations. The attack was not executed at full scale; certificates show the construction works, not its cost.
baseline_improved names the organizer nominal reference as required metadata; comparison with the Yukon incumbent is left to Yukon.

heuristics.statement: For one trial (marginally a uniform 512-bit first block M0) and CV = C(IV, M0): (a) the probability that the trial wins is at least half its value for uniform CV; (b) Pr[CV in P] <= 2^10 * 33 * 2^-50; (c) Pr[A_-1 is one of the 2336 table keys] <= 2 * 2336 * 2^-32.
heuristics.scope: Fixed target, advice and tables; the prefix-valid set P (59-bit condition on A_-1, A_-2, A_-3), its winning subset and the 32-bit key event. (a) gives the success bound; (b) and (c) bound the probability of reaching the caps.
heuristics.extrapolation: Our measurements on real 31-step chaining values, for both fresh uniform blocks and the grouped generation actually used, check the 32-bit key event and the 41-bit key+W6 event against uniform predictions; extrapolated to the full 59-bit condition and the c18 completion condition (probability about 2^-45 and 2^-47.8).
heuristics.limitations: Own measurements, not organizer-executed. Nothing is measured about the last 18 bits (W5 test on A_-3) or about c18. Sensitivity: ratio rho instead of 1/2 in (a) gives success bound 1 - exp(-1.0334*rho) - 0.0085 (0.383 at rho = 0.48, 0.636 at rho = 1).

heuristics.statement: For a uniform chaining value conditioned on lying in P with c18 in S, the capped completion search of proof Section 7 finds (W13, W14, W15) with probability at least 0.99.
heuristics.scope: Phase 3 on the advice states after step 12 for the 64 values of W16 in G16 and uniform c16; |S| = 584683520 is an exact count, not part of the premise.
heuristics.extrapolation: From our simulation over 4*2^22 uniform (c16, c18) (2,282,381 with c18 in S, all completed and verified) and the organizer experiment on the published prefix, to all prefixes Phase 2 can produce.
heuristics.limitations: Simulation is our own run (an independent run in 654cb3d agrees). The organizer experiment uses one prefix with many offsets. Sensitivity: completion rate 0.9 gives success bound 0.366; 0.39 needs about 0.975.

heuristics.statement: The computations that produced the advice (the 31-step characteristic search of Li-Liu-Wang 2024 and all collision runs of Li-Liu-Wang-Dong-Sun 2024 leading to the published pair) cost at most 2^45 target-compression units.
heuristics.scope: One-time work behind the 188-byte advice, at 2^23 units per thread-second. The published 1.2 h on 64 threads is < 2^41.08 units; the remaining > 2^44.9 units (about 1,000 thread-hours) cover the unpublished characteristic search and the additional runs mentioned by the authors (a first run that succeeded in seconds and further experiments).
heuristics.extrapolation: The characteristic-search time is not published. A partial third-party re-run of the authors' public script reported in 654cb3d took 58,015 CPU-seconds for 24 STP calls (< 2^38.83 units); the allowance is about 64 times that.
heuristics.limitations: Historical and partly third-party evidence; we did not re-run STP. Volume of the authors' additional collision runs is unstated. Sensitivity of the total: T0 = 2^46 gives 2^47.79, 2^47 gives 2^48.16, 2^48 gives 2^48.69.

heuristics.statement: For two distinct trials of one group (same W0..W14, W15 differing by a nonzero offset), the probability that both win is at most 2^20 * q_U^2, where q_U is the per-trial win probability for uniform CV.
heuristics.scope: Only the Bonferroni correction eps = L * 2^20 * q_U < 2^-11.84 of proof Section 10; per-trial marginal probabilities follow exactly from Lemma 4 and do not use H4.
heuristics.extrapolation: The two chaining values differ through 16 full steps after the first differing word; the premise allows a 2^20-fold correlation excess over independence. Grouped H1 measurements show no excess of 32-bit and 41-bit events.
heuristics.limitations: Within-group co-occurrence of the 59-bit event cannot be sampled. Sensitivity: even 2^24 * q_U^2 lowers the success bound by less than 0.002.
